# FDG3056

> DO add the suffix “Exception.”

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.2 Names of Common Types. Applies to: System.Exception.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1710
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

CA1710 reports a class derived from System.Exception, directly or through another class such as ArgumentException, whose name does not end with Exception. It checks the whole hierarchy because the package sets dotnet_code_quality.CA1710.exclude_indirect_base_types = false (see FDG3048; probe with SDK 10.0.403). On the noise samples the option added 2 CA1710 reports, both true and neither for this suffix (docs/noise-samples.md). Renaming a public type changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1710 has no code fix.
